what: HSBC is one of the world's largest banks, with its strongest positions in Hong Kong and the UK. It takes deposits, lends, runs wealth management and finances international trade.
customers: Households, wealthy clients, companies that trade across borders and large institutions.
money: retail and commercial banking in its two home markets
wealth and premier banking, mainly in Asia
moat: A deposit base in Hong Kong that is very hard to copy and a network that connects Asia with the rest of the world.
risks: China and Hong Kong property losses
Tension between China and the West
